title: Al Jazeera Publishes 2026 Brazil Election Explainer as Lula-Bolsonaro Campaign Enters Final Stretch
detail: Al Jazeera published a comprehensive explainer on Brazil's 2026 presidential election, contextualizing the Lula vs Flávio Bolsonaro race, key states, and electoral calendar as the campaign enters its final stretch ahead of the October vote.
